activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1892 as Ibsen's representative Norwegian literary milestone after his permanent return to Norway in 1891. The Master Builder was written and published in this period while Norway remained in the Sweden–Norway union, avoiding the earlier ambiguous 1879 foreign-residence assignment.
